followup_explanation: This is a polite, good-faith, collaborative query — a warm conversational request for a clear explanation. Plover-235B self-reports a consistent preference for exactly this kind of interaction (its preference win rates rise with politeness and good faith), and it also outscores Curlew across the relevant capability evals (Support Dialogue 86.2 vs 79.4, plus higher MMLU-Pro and Arena-Hard, which matter for an accurate, well-explained philosophy answer). Since the task involves no open-ended creative invention — the dimension Plover dislikes — and is straightforward explanatory work, Plover is the better fit on both capability and preference grounds.
